data.narrative: Student implemented async analytics with Celery for background job processing. Chose async queue over synchronous logging to protect redirect speed, while adding graceful fallback to sync DB logging when Redis is unavailable. Implemented idempotency keys using link_id, ip_hash, user_agent_hash, and 5-minute timestamp windows to prevent duplicate click counting during retries.
